notes: *upon them* is `added`: וַתִּפֹּל שְׁבָא writes neither a preposition nor an object, so rule 44's supplied-object clause and rule 30 leave the pair with no morpheme to carry them. Rule 44's supplied-preposition permission does not reach it, since that clause requires a bare direct object to be written in the Hebrew.
The waw s007 takes the connective *yea*, which rule 14 reads off the ASV.
לְבַדִּי → *alone* fuses as one three-morpheme unit headed on בַּד (rule 30).
